basis.stock_selection: All 20 completed final-clock repeats, matching audit vectors, TRICERATOPS_KEPLER_V3, 1,000,000 attempted draws per scenario and CPU budget 5; survey and M/K case trees.
basis.excluded: First-two futility exits, controls/calibration, prior V1/V2 protocols, and duplicate probability-stock folders without a matching final audit.

timing_boundaries.stock: First preserved completed attempt start to earliest matching twenty-repeat audit; includes first-repeat compilation, all twenty attempts and preservation, but excludes coordinator startup before the first attempt.
timing_boundaries.engine: Recorded launch wall time through workflow completion, including process startup, first-two gate, all twenty repeats and preservation; excludes later physical review.
timing_boundaries.both: Acquisition, native fitting, preparation and scientific closeout excluded.

interpretation: Historical cohorts show approximately 2.1-2.6x shorter median elapsed time for the new twenty-repeat probability stage at the same five-core budget; the exposure-integration-restricted comparison is 2.46x.
limits: Different targets and machine-load conditions; ratios describe observed cohorts and do not isolate a causal implementation speedup.
The all-campaign stock group includes three cases with 40 or 80 exposure samples; the 20-sample and M/K comparisons remove them.
A stock-versus-engine replay of identical frozen inputs would isolate implementation gain, but is not required to describe these historical production timings.
Integrity and normalization checks do not constitute physical validation.
